name: EPIC 251522539
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 15.6 solar radii and 1.12 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 251522539 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.569791 (16th-84th percentiles 14.452131-16.55027), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 251522539 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5676.25 (16th-84th percentiles 5418.4375-5921.640625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,676 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.12 solar masses and 15.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,846 K at its surface.
